## Objective
A playable browser front end: canvas rendering, keyboard controls and a game loop on top of `src/logic.js`, with no build step or dependencies.

## Interface
`index.html` loads `<script type="module" src="src/main.js">` and `style.css`, contains a `<canvas id="board">` and elements `#score` and `#message`. `src/main.js` imports `{ createState, turn, tick }` from `./logic.js` (see stub for types; the real implementation arrives from another task, rely only on the stub's contract).

## Behavior
1. Grid 20x20, cell 24px; canvas sized accordingly.
2. A timer calls tick every 120 ms while status is 'running'.
3. Arrow keys and WASD call turn; arrow keys call preventDefault.
4. Draw background, snake (head a distinct colour) and food each frame, and update `#score`.
5. On 'over' or 'won' show a message in `#message` ("Game over" / "You win") with "Press Space to restart".
6. Space restarts with a fresh createState; Space also starts the game from an initial "Press Space to start" paused state.

## Invariants
Plain ES modules and CSS; works when served statically; all game rules stay in logic.js.

## Edge cases
Ignore key repeat flooding (turn is idempotent); restart must clear the old timer so speed does not stack.

## Guardrails
Do not modify `src/logic.js`. No external CDNs or npm packages.

## Out of scope
Sound, high scores, touch controls, tests.
